title: Consumer Care Email Address (optional)
description: Detect whether an email address for consumer complaints is declared on the package. Rule 6(2) states the email address is required 'if available' — it is not mandatory. This rule is informational only and does NOT affect the screening score. It provides additional evidence for the consumer care declaration.
amendment_status: Rule 6(2) was substituted by G.S.R. 385(E), 14 May 2015 to add email address requirement ('if available').
applicable_scope: All pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale.

detection_method.description: OCR extracts all text. The system searches for email address patterns, ideally near consumer-care-related keywords.

validation_logic.pass_criteria: An email address pattern is found on the label, ideally near consumer-care keywords.

evaluate.action: Search for email patterns (primary_patterns), filtering out test/placeholder domains
Check if any email is near consumer-care keywords
If email_matches non-empty → DETECTED. If no email found → NOT_DETECTED (informational, no score impact).

observable_evidence.description: What the software can observe: text containing an email address pattern, ideally near consumer-care-related keywords.

status_values.DETECTED: An email address was found on the label, optionally near consumer-care keywords.
status_values.NOT_DETECTED: No email address was found. This is NOT a compliance failure — email is 'if available'.
status_values.UNCERTAIN: An email-like pattern was found but context is ambiguous.
status_values.NOT_APPLICABLE: Product is exempt under Rule 3 or Rule 26.

cannot_conclude: Whether the email address is active or belongs to the manufacturer/packer
Whether the email is the correct contact for consumer complaints
Whether the absence of email is a violation (it is NOT — email is 'if available')
notes: Rule 6(2): 'Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, e mail address, if available, of the person who can be or the office which can be, contacted, in case of consumer complaints.'
The email address is explicitly optional ('if available'). This rule is informational only.
This rule does NOT affect the screening score. Absence of email is not a compliance issue.
The phone number check (MVP-A5) covers the mandatory part of Rule 6(2).
limitations: OCR may misread email addresses (e.g., '@' as 'at', '.' as ',').
Some packages may not have an email address visible on the scanned portion of the label.
The system cannot verify that the email address is valid or monitored.
